an6.54:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an6.54:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Dhammiko jātibhūmiyaṃ āvāsiko hoti sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattasu āvāsesu.
an6.54:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ āyasmā Dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya,
an6.54:1.4: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā Dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti, na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:2.1: Atha kho jātibhūmikānaṃ upāsakānaṃ etad ahosi
an6.54:2.3: atha kho pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ;
an6.54:2.4: ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo yena āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsan' ti?
an6.54:2.5: Atha kho jātibhūmikānaṃ upāsakānaṃ etad ahosi
an6.54:2.6: ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā Dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya,
an6.54:2.7: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā Dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ;
an6.54:2.8: yan nūna mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ pabbājeyyāmā' ti.
an6.54:3.1: Atha kho jātibhūmikā upāsakā yena āyasmā Dhammiko ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ etad avocuṃ
an6.54:3.4: Atha kho āyasmā Dhammiko tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
an6.54:3.5: Tatra pi sudaṃ āyasmā Dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya,
an6.54:3.6: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā Dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:4.1: Atha kho jātibhūmikānaṃ upāsakānaṃ etad ahosi
an6.54:4.3: atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ;
an6.54:4.4: ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo yena āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsan' ti?
an6.54:4.5: Atha kho jātibhūmikānaṃ upāsakānaṃ etad ahosi
an6.54:4.6: ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā Dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya,
an6.54:4.7: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā Dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ;
an6.54:4.8: yan nūna mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ pabbājeyyāmā' ti.
an6.54:5.1: Atha kho jātibhūmikā upāsakā yena āyasmā Dhammiko ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ etad avocuṃ
an6.54:5.2: ‘pakkamatu bhante āyasmā Dhammiko imamhā pi āvāsā,
an6.54:5.4: Atha kho āyasmā Dhammiko tamhā pi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
an6.54:5.5: Tatra pi sudaṃ āyasmā Dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati vihiṃsati vitudati roseti vācāya,
an6.54:5.6: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā Dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ.
an6.54:6.1: Atha kho jātibhūmikānaṃ upāsakānaṃ etad ahosi
an6.54:6.3: atha ca pana āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ;
an6.54:6.4: ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo yena āgantukā bhikkhū pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsan' ti?
an6.54:6.5: Atha kho jātibhūmikānaṃ upāsakānaṃ etad ahosi ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā Dhammiko āgantuke bhikkhū akkosati . . . pe . . .
an6.54:6.6: roseti vācāya, te ca āgantukā bhikkhū āyasmatā Dhammikena akkosiyamānā paribhāsiyamānā vihesiyamānā vitudiyamānā rosiyamānā vācāya pakkamanti na saṇṭhanti, riñcanti āvāsaṃ; yan nūna mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ pabbājeyyāma sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī' ti.
an6.54:6.7: Atha kho jātibhūmikā upāsakā yena āyasmā Dhammiko ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ etad avocuṃ
an6.54:6.8: ‘pakkamatu bhante āyasmā Dhammiko sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī' ti. 4.
an6.54:6.9: Atha kho āyasmato Dhammikassa etad ahosi
an6.54:6.10: ‘pabbājito kho 'mhi jātibhūmikehi upāsakehi sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehi,
an6.54:6.11: kahan nu kho dāni gacchāmī' ti?
an6.54:6.12: Atha kho āyasmato Dhammikassa etad ahosi
an6.54:6.13: ‘yan nūnāhaṃ yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkammeyyan' ti.
an6.54:7.1: Atha kho āyasmā Dhammiko pattacīvaram ādāya yena Rājagahaṃ tena pakkāmi,
an6.54:7.2: anupubbena yena Rājagahaṃ Gijjhakūṭo pabbato, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Dhammikaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca
an6.54:7.3: ‘handa kuto nu tvaṃ brāhmaṇa Dhammika āgacchasī' ti?
an6.54:7.4: ‘Pabbājito ahaṃ bhante jātibhūmikehi upāsakehi sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī' ti.
an6.54:7.5: Alaṃ brāhmaṇa Dhammika, kin te iminā? Yan taṃ tato tato pabbājenti, so tvaṃ tato tato pabbājito mam eva santike āgacchasi. 5.
an6.54:8.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa Dhammika sāmuddikā vāṇijā tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ gahetvā nāvāya samuddaṃ ajjhogāhanti.
an6.54:8.2: Te atīradakkhiṇiyā nāvāya tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ muñcanti.
an6.54:8.3: So gacchat'eva puratthimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ, gacchati anudisaṃ.
an6.54:8.4: Sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathā gatako 'va hoti.
an6.54:8.5: Sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati, tam eva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati.
an6.54:8.6: Evam eva kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika, yan taṃ tato tato pabbājenti, so tvaṃ tato tato pabbājito mam'eva santike āgacchasi. 6.
an6.54:9.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa Dhammika rañño Koravyassa Suppatiṭṭho nāma nigrodharājā ahosi pañcasākho sītacchāyo manoramo.
an6.54:9.2: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika nigrodharājassa dvādasa yojanāni abhiniveso ahosi, pañca yojanāni mūlasantānakānaṃ.
an6.54:9.3: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika nigrodharājassa tāva mahantāni phalāni ahesuṃ.
an6.54:9.6: seyyathā pi nāma khuddaṃ madhuṃ anīlakaṃ.
an6.54:9.7: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika nigrodharājassa ekaṃ khandhaṃ rājā paribhuñjati saddhiṃ itthāgārena, ekaṃ khandhaṃ balakāyo paribhuñjati, ekaṃ khandhaṃ negamajānapadā paribhuñjanti, ekaṃ khandhaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇā paribhuñjanti, ekaṃ khandhaṃ migapakkhiyo paribhuñjanti.
an6.54:9.8: Suppatiṭṭhassa kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika nigrodharājassa na koci phalāni rakkhati. Na ca sudam aññamaññassa phalāni hiṃsanti.
an6.54:10.1: Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika aññataro puriso Suppatiṭṭhassa nigrodharājassa yāvadatthaṃ phalāni bhakkhitvā sākhaṃ bhañjitvā pakkāmi.
an6.54:10.2: Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika Suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthāya devatāya etad ahosi
an6.54:10.4: yāva pāpo manusso yatra hi nāma Suppatiṭṭhassa nigrodharājassa yāvadatthaṃ phalāni bhakkhitvā sākhaṃ bhañjitvā pakkamissati, yan nūna Suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā āyatiṃ phalaṃ na dadeyyā' ti.
an6.54:10.5: Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika Suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā āyatiṃ phalaṃ nādāsi.
an6.54:11.1: Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika rājā Koravyo yena Sakko devānam indo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ etad avoca
an6.54:11.2: ‘yagghe mārisa jāneyyāsi, Suppatiṭṭho nigrodharājā phalaṃ na detī' ti?
an6.54:11.3: Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika Sakko devānam indo tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi, yathā bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā Suppatiṭṭhaṃ nigrodharājaṃ pātesi ummūlam akāsi.
an6.54:11.4: Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika Suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthā devatā dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
an6.54:12.1: Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika Sakko devānam indo yena Suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthā devatā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Suppatiṭṭhe nigrodharāje adhivatthaṃ devataṃ etad avoca
an6.54:12.2: ‘kin nu tvaṃ devate dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā ekamantaṃ ṭhitā' ti?
an6.54:12.3: ‘Tathā hi pana me mārisa bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pātesi ummūlam akāsī' ti.
an6.54:12.4: ‘Api nu tvaṃ devate rukkhadhamme ṭhitāya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pātesi ummūlam akāsī' ti?
an6.54:12.5: ‘Kathaṃ pana mārisa rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotī' ti?
an6.54:12.6: ‘Idh'eva devate rukkhassa mūlaṃ mūlatthikā haranti, tacaṃ tacatthikā haranti, pattaṃ pattatthikā haranti, pupphaṃ pupphatthikā haranti, phalaṃ phalatthika haranti,
an6.54:12.7: na ca tena devatāya anattamanatā vā anabhinandi vā karaṇīyā:
an6.54:12.8: evaṃ kho devate rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotī' ti.
an6.54:12.9: ‘Aṭṭhitāy' eva kho me mārisa rukkhadhamme bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā bhavanaṃ pātesi ummūlam akāsī' ti.
an6.54:12.10: ‘Sace kho tvaṃ devate rukkhadhamme tiṭṭheyyāsi, siyā pi te bhavanaṃ yathāpure' ti.
an6.54:12.11: Thassām' ahaṃ mārisa rukkhadhamme, hotu me bhavanaṃ yathāpure' ti.
an6.54:13.1: ‘Atha kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika Sakko devānam indo tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi, yathā bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā Suppatiṭṭham nigrodharājaṃ ussāpesi, sacchavīni mūlāni ahesuṃ.
an6.54:13.2: Evam eva kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika api nu taṃ samaṇadhamme ṭhitaṃ jātibhūmikā upāsakā pabbājeyyuṃ sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī' ti?
an6.54:13.3: ‘Kathaṃ pana bhante samaṇo samaṇadhamme ṭhito hotī' ti?
an6.54:13.4: ‘Idha brāhmaṇa Dhammika samaṇo akkosantaṃ na paccakkosati, rosantaṃ na paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ na paṭibhaṇḍati:
an6.54:13.5: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika samaṇo samaṇadhamme ṭhito hotī' ti.
an6.54:13.6: ‘Aṭṭhitaṃ yeva kho maṃ bhante samaṇadhamme jātibhūmikā upāsakā pabbājesuṃ sabbaso jātibhūmiyaṃ sattahi āvāsehī' ti. 7.
an6.54:13.7: Bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa Dhammika Sunetto nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
an6.54:13.8: Sunettassa kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
an6.54:13.9: Sunetto satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desesi.
an6.54:13.10: Ye kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika Sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an6.54:13.11: Ye kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika Sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an6.54:14.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa Dhammika Mugapakkho nāma satthā ahosi . . . pe . . .
an6.54:18.1: Jotipālo nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
an6.54:18.2: Jotipālassa kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
an6.54:18.3: Jotipālo satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desesi.
an6.54:18.4: Ye kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika Jotipālassa satthuno brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an6.54:18.5: Ye kho pana brāhmaṇa Dhammika Jotipālassa satthuno brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an6.54:19.2: yo ime cha satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyyā ti?
an6.54:19.4: Yo kho brāhmaṇa Dhammika ime cha satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyya.
an6.54:19.5: Yo ekaṃ diṭṭhisampannaṃ puggalaṃ paduṭṭhacitto akkosati paribhāsati, ayaṃ tato bahutaraṃ apuññaṃ pasavati.
an6.54:19.7: Nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa Dhammika ito bahiddhā evarūpiṃ khantiṃ vadāmi yathā 'maṃ sabrahmacārīsu.
an6.54:19.8: Tasmā ti ha brāhmaṇa Dhammika evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 9.
an6.54:19.9: Na no sabrahmacārīsu cittāni paduṭṭhāni bhavissantī ti. Evaṃ
an6.54:19.10: hi te brāhmaṇa Dhammika sikkhitabban ti.
